name: e06_vision_only
role: DESCRIPTIVE comparison: does the Kalman tracker/controller need leader-speed telemetry? Not a confirmatory test (3 seeds per cell).

notes: Detector best_realistic_v2.pt in all arms. on_rs = reference with leader speed. on_vo = same structure with leader speed estimated from camera + own speed (q=6 chosen on development seeds). on_pv = strict: camera + own commands only, no speed sensor or heading.
